review_description: Excellent service from start to finish. Mike (in sales) was incredibly patient in explaining the different options available to us. We took our time, compared different offerings from other companies and had multiple helpful discussions with Mike before deciding Green Wave was the company with the product that we wanted. Then their administration was really prompt/efficient and the installers were professional, friendly, informative and left the job site immaculately clean. I have no hesitation in recommending Green Wave Solar.
Sales process went very well. They were extremely helpful, prompt and courteous

I've had a few dealings with Green Wave Solar over recent years. I cannot fault them. Two years ago they upgraded my then 13 year old solar system, and this month they installed a new battery storage system.The sales/quoting process was straightforward. The installation was timely and efficient. After sales/installation service was trouble-free. Overall it's not a "cheap" process, but I've paid for good quality and good service, and I'm satisfied with the costings.Over the years my dealings with the team have always been professional, efficient and friendly. They are happy to deal with my "dumb" questions, and it's always been handy to be able to pop into the office in town on the very odd occasion that I needed to sort something out.Very happy to recommend.

From quoting our system to the final installation of our system Green Wave provided exceptional service. They provided good quality product advice and worked seamlessly with our builder to execute the installation process. Installers are professional, clean and tidy and willing to provide informative advice on installation and start up. The system was pretty much plug and play, everything was done for us. After sales service second to none. Our system has been running for 6 months with no issues.

From the first call to GreenWave, it was amazing, they replaced my 10-year-old system that didn't want to work any-longer.The explanation of Australian Standards, why and what was required.The quote was broken down into 3 options, making it very easy to understand.The removal of the old system to the repairs required to my roof, to the time of arrival.The install process was brilliant, the young men installers, were happy to explain the process,Explained the APP, Explained the reconnect to the grid, to the next steps to the new meter.They even left my garage floor tidier than when they arrived.
Great overall Customer Service.Sales process was seem less - quotes within 24 hours.Installation team did a great professional job - in and out within 5 hours.

Excellent customer service from start to finish. They came to our house and designed a system to suit our wants AND needs. No pushy salesman just honest and friendly knowledgeable conversation. Matt was amazing....the nicest salesman l have ever met.They designed our system, organised everything and the installers did a wonderfully tidy and efficient job. The fact that they are local gives me peace of mind IF l do have any issues.I would definitely recommend them to anyone thinking of going solar.

The customer service was second to none, asked three companies for a quote, only Green Wave gave any service, well done. We will certainly be recommending Green Wave to friends and family, the whole process was excellent. Installers were excellent, friendly and very tidy. We really didn't have to do anything and there was follow up from the office to ensure we were happy and everything was working and connected.

After many years of research, waiting and loads of solar quotes I chose Green Wave due to the following reasons.1. The sales consultant Mike is qualified in solar passive design, as he offers you only the best design for your house. He is not there to just sell you a system and make a quick dollar. He will only design a system that will give you maximum returns from the panels and inverter based on your needs.2. The company only offers the best panels, mounting frames and inverters.3. The crew that installed the system were professional, accurate, polite, and made sure the work was done to a high standard. They left not mess and ensured I understood how to operate the system.4. As a local company should I have any issues or queries they are available to assist and willing to assist. So far everything is working above expectations.While I may have paid slightly more than other solar companies I have ended up with the best of the best solar panels, mounting frames and inverter. Before we signed, we were concerned about how our panels would look as they are facing the street. When we looked around our suburb many of the solar panels installed by other companies look cheap and are not aesthetically appealing. Ours look great from the street, love the all black look.I will be using Green Wave to install a battery later this year as I trust them to only offer me the best batteries at a fair price.Thanks, Green Wave

I highly recommend GWS for a PV Solar system.  The enthusiasm I witnessed from start to finish (covering discovery, quotation, site preparation, installation and commissioning) was fantastic.  This work was all done with accommodating my many questions all the way.
Very impressed with the install by their own team of electricians who knew exactly what to do. Very neat and tidy, were all done in 4 hours. System works a treat!

Green wave solar were incredibly helpful and professional in the entire process.Price was almost half of what I was quoted by door knockers from PerthInstallation was professional and in a timely manner

Green Wave did a great job from start to finish.  Lovely sales, prompt and professional administration and installation.  Thank you to solar quotes and greenwave for helping us with our solar investment

I spoke to Chris last Wednesday 29 January, got the quote, made an informed decision AND we had our solar panels and full system installed and completed Tuesday   4 February, less than 7 days........ bloody ripperA big shout out to the installers, polite and considerate all the way.... Thanks BoysMy Advice to anyone thinking TO  GO Solar in the future, Chris and his Green Solar team should be your first choiceThanksGreen Solar
Had 6.56 kw REC Pure Panels installed in South West WA with Fronius Gen24 Inverter, quality Products and First Class Installation, thanks Chris and your Team,Regards,Mark
Good presentation, good service. Timely install by a competent team. All clearly explained.

The team were fantastic throughout the entire process. Great technical advice from our initial inquiry, awesome support through the approvals, and professional and timely installation. Clear communications and guidance. Thoroughly recommended.
Green wave solar great service from start to finish all staff friendly and polite and great to work with .cheers

From the first quote to the minute they left the driveway, the whole procedure was seamless. The sales person knew exactly what he was talking about in terms of the "science" and was freely available to answer questions regarding the system both prior to, and after the installation. The crew that did the installation arrived promptly on the designated date, and were able to do the full job (including a battery wall) in the one day. It was connected to the household wifi and we were walked through the set-up and workings of the system. The Solarweb app makes for very easy analysis of the activity of the system. Very pleased with outcome.
Great communication from day 1, across the whole team.Efficient turnaround from quote to install.Thoroughly answered all my questions.Very happy customer, highly recommended

I'm not one to normally use an online quoting system but decided to add some easy extra quotes to my 10 yrs of researching and waiting and trying to find the right time.Green Wave came back promptly with a great suggested package, quality equipment and a fair price.They followed up a few times while I was still a bit indecisive in a polite and non intrusive way.Communication was spot on all the way thru the process,installation no issues even with a few extra considerations we had to manage with our set up.Deciding to go for it was the hard part,Greenwave made the rest easy and I'm now enjoying the daily stats seeing the system perform.

Green Wave Solar were a pleasure to deal with, from the quotation process to the completion of the installation. Communication was great at every step of the project including during the installation, which had to be undertaken when we were away from the property. After sales support has also been faultless. I would not hesitate to recommend this company.
The whole process was very professional, from the beginning.The installation was an example of a well organised team, being completed quickly and efficiently

Our experience was excellent from start to finish. We met at the office to discuss our needs and where all our questions were answered clearly.  A couple of days later the electrician visited to assess the building. We then received 2 quotations with the cost being in the vicinity of our expectations. The company did all the required 'paper work' with Western Power and the Dept. of Energy and Mines.With approval granted, an installation date was scheduled and the team arrived and had the job finished in one morning. The 4 person team were all polite and courteous. We were able to inspect the job on completion and were guided through how the system works. The following day we were sent information on how to install and use the system 'app'.All in all, a professional job with very nice people.

From start to finish Chris and the team did a fantastic job. We have had solar 2 solar installations before in another state so knew what to expect. Through the whole process we were very happy with advice, actual quote and communication. Jack and the boys did a fast neat and tidy installation. We would have no trouble recommending Green Wave Solar to anyone.
Impressive from the start with rapid response for detailed quote, great team of installers and professional approach overall

All the staff at Green Wave Solar were very helpful and efficient. From quoting to installation it was very quick and once again efficient.  The team who did the installation were very professional, polite and respectful.  They were always very jovial and advised me at every point of what they were doing.Green Wave Solar have kept in touch with me at all times and are never too busy to help.I want to thank all the staff and tradesmen at Green Wave Solar for all their help and assistance, the experience has been great.  Thank you!!

We were impressed by the prompt response to our requests.The working of the systems and options were given in an easy way for us to understand .Work was done effectively and efficientlyGrid connection was done for us.Customer service has been excellent
Full credit to the Green Wave Team. Very professional people to deal with. We are very satisfied with our choice from sales to installation and hand over.   Mac

Cannot recommend this company more highly. Excellent quality product and fantastic service, from finding the right system for us and a smooth and clean installation. This guys are super friendly aswell.

Green Wave Solar responded quickly to my request for information and quotation. Answered all my questions. Only recommended quality panels, invertors and battery's. The installation team were very polite, efficient and tidy. The commissioning and use of the system was explained very well. The app on your phone allows for easy monitoring and efficient use of household appliances to utilize solar production and have the battery at 100% ready for night time use. My journey into the world of solar was seamless with Green Wave Solar. Very happy and appreciative of the team at GWS.
Sales and system design customised to site constraints, objectives and future aspirations.Prompt, tidy and fault free installation.Splendid after sales service
Easy to deal with. Told them what we wanted and they designed a suitable system and sorted everything out.  Timeframe to order and install was quicker than expected.

I recently had the pleasure of working with Green Wave Solar, and I couldn't be more impressed with their service. During our initial phone call, I was presented with three pricing options ranging from budget to premium. The quotes were detailed and competitive, making my decision easier.The level of professionalism continued when an electrician and his team visited to inspect the installation site and ensure everything, including the internet connection, would work seamlessly. The installation itself was completed well within the promised timeframe. The team was polite, tidy, and efficient.Green Wave Solar handled everything for me, even providing a USB with all the necessary warranty information. Setting up my Fronius account was straightforward, thanks to their clear email instructions. Any questions I had were promptly answered, and I received a follow-up email with tips on how to use the system effectively.Overall, Green Wave Solar exceeded my expectations in every aspect. Their excellent customer service and attention to detail made the entire process smooth and stress-free.

Price competitive for the region using high quality components. They beat the cheap, national or Perth advertisers once regional travel and same quality components were included.Installation was clean, punctual and quick. Installers were clean, well mannered and informative.The whole process couldn't have been easier. Green Wave Solar did everything from planning to installing and organising grid connection and approvals. We just signed documents as requested and paid the bill.
Found the installers friendly and courteous, very efficient and left premises clean and tidy

Kane responded quickly with a quote and revised it as soon as I requested some different components to what was originally quoted.He was there installing it with his team within a short timeframe and was very helpful in explaining the details of how it operates.The quote itemised the charges and the installation cost was reasonable.I highly recommend Greenwave Solar Pty Ltd, situated in Busselton, Western Australia.
Very easy install with a great team - very professional and responsive.
The sales and quoting process work very well, everybody was prompt and had the quotes to us very quickly.The installation when very well and the team was easy to deal with, they did a good tidy job.

We were very happy with our experience with Green Wave.  The quotation process was fast and efficient.  The installation went smoothly even though the weather was appalling that day. All our questions have been dealt with promptly and the team has been very helpful.

The team at Green Wave were fast and efficient with minimal inconvenience. They were very professional and left the place as if they hadn’t been here at all! And the staff at the office were informative and very easy to consult with. I will definitely recommend them in the future. Thanks guys.

Having known Chris for a number years I had no hesitiation in having Green Wave Solar install our new PV system. Their quote and savings forecasts were all very comprehensive and the lead up to install was smooth.The installation was very smooth, the team went out of their way to make sure I was fully informed.They also cleaned up the electrical switchboard which was needed and meant we didn't have to organise a second electrician.Have no hesitation in recommending Green Wave Solar. Extremely satisfied with the process from start to finish. Thanks Chris for making our solar journey so enjoyable
The whole process from quote to install & follow up was very straightforward.Everything was organised for us.Customer service was easy & punctual.

I needed to have my old solar system replaced, so after a bit of time spent on research on the Solar Reviews website, then getting information and quotes from my local solar retailers (in South West W.A.), I ended up choosing Green Wave Solar to install a complete new system. They were not the cheapest, but gave me the most comprehensive and realistic information, and once I had set the process in motion, the guys were on time with their installation dates. On the day they were scheduled to install, it was one of the hottest days of the summer (over 40 deg C), yet they were on the roof for hours in that heat, and got the whole job completed and operational as planned. The only thing I would have liked more instruction of, was how to interpret the Fronius App properly. A follow up a few days later would have been appreciated, and while I did not ask for this myself, the offer would have been really appreciated. Apart from that (very minor), note, I was super happy with the guys, the company, and the performance of my new system. I have since recommended them on line and personally and will again.

Right from the quote all the way to installation and even after sales service, Matt and his team did an awesome job. Great knowledge of their product and workmanship cant be faulted. Cant recommend them enough! thanks guys
Process was easy from quote to installation. Very honest and straightforward and punctual.Helped with connection.
Quote was accurateAfter service has been greatTop TeamProfessional

Very efficient installers and super friendly guys.I stumbled a bit with my Wattpilot car charger but Chris had a guy around in hours to help me set up my App on my phone.Love the Tesla battery I didn't even know the power had gone off until Tesla sent me a text telling me the Grid had gone down and I was now running on battery power.I highly recommend Green Wave Solar

When I was initially gathering quotes for transitioning to solar, Green Wave was the only installer/supplier to actually visit onsite and provide an opportunity to discuss any issues I had re the install. They were easy to contact and always responded promptly. I found the whole process to be timely and professional. Already I've seen a significant reduction in my energy bills. Cheers to all at Green Wave.
The installation was efficient and the staff were very friendly.
The quality of the installation and equipment was superb. The whole process was simple and was done in a professional and effective manner.I am very happy with the result.

Polite, punctual and professional service. Not pushy sales people and advised us on the quantity of panels needed based on our usage.Competitive price and value for money. Would recommend this company to anybody!
I highly recommend Green Wave Solar for a quality and professional service.Great job guys
Excellent service and communication from start to finish. All the guys were very professional and we are very happy .
No chasing, no mess, no waiting. Just good old fashioned excellent, speedy, good quality service.
Great company, solar products good and service was fantastic.
Good cooperative and smooth installation even though we had internet issues.

Solar is such a difficult product to work out which product is superior as …..a builder I see soo many quotes for similar products that you have to be a specialist to know what your actually looking atGreen wave have been fantastic to deal with ,Chris and his teams up front approach and professionalism is extremely refreshing and I can’t fault the service or the product
Super impressive, a quality system installed in good time. Professional from start to finish. Great people to deal with.

From the initial contact with Green Wave Solar through too the installation, we were kept informed on developments in a timely manner .We felt that we were listened to in all aspects of the process, from initial research into a suitable system , queries regarding cost and the products used and on-site queries while the installation was taking place.The team of installers were friendly , efficient, punctual and tidy on the job.

The call back was prompt, 3 options were provided with different panels and inverters to choose.All very uncomplicated and straight forward, however somehow there was a misunderstanding reg. the smart meter which I thought was included in the price as I had mentioned I would like one.Green Wave handled Western Power applications etc.The install team was very friendly, respectful of our house and fast.All is running well although we haven't received our first power bill yet.A different provider has quoted the same components for quite a bit cheaper, however they seemed so unorganized, that I decided to pay the higher price for better service (the cheaper provider had arranged a quotation with me on site but never showed and I got calls from 3 different sales reps).Would recommend Green Wave to family and friends and choose again for solar install.

The whole process from initial contact to completion was smooth and seamless. They basically did everything for me. The information and service I received was genuine and well-explained and I am very happy with the outcome so far.
Excellent service,professional friendly team and quality workmanship. Highly recommended.

Sales guy was great and informative. The friendly installation team went well with the guys leaving the property tidy like they hadn’t been there. After service was good too, they organised everything with the energy companies and we downloaded the app ready to flick the switch once given the go ahead. The quote was not the cheapest to choose from ,but the quality of the products and service was excellent & very happy to recommend them.

I previously had a quote from Greenwave Solar. Their team did a site visit and suggested what would be required for my needs. I subsequently revisited the quote and decided to proceed. The team were prompt and efficient and once on site, the system was operational in a few hours.The Fronius inverter and wifi app work perfectly and gives me real time information.This company is a pleasure to deal with

Quoting was easy, after initial phone consult we were given several options and all questions were thoroughly answered to make an informed choice.Installation was done within days .The Team of 5 arrived on time (in fact a little earlier, Great) and had the job done in 3.5 hours. The guys were very friendly, efficient, polite and James answered all my questions patiently.They left the site tidy and the panels look great .All applications and the Grid connection was all done by Solar Wave and Chris helped set up monitoring through the Fronius App . So all up from signing the contract we were operational within the week without any issues .Fantastic service , highly recommend and very happy to finally be producing solar power

Offered a competitive price for a high quality system.The salesman had a genuine approach rather than sales tactics, the installation team were quick, professional, cleaned up after themselves and communicated well.Not much more I could have asked for..

From the point of enquiry to installation the device was exceptional throughout. There was no delay in installation on time and the process was efficient carried out by 2 knowledgeable tradesmen. At each stage of the process there was effective communication with continued reassurance. Their motto was “we have it under control”. Grid connection by the installer completed a very stress free exercise.

Thank you Chris, Matt & Team @ Green Wave Solar the whole process was hassle free.The help & advice given over the quoting, managing & installation stages was exceptional & their team all workedtogether effectively on site.Very pleased with the end result.
From the quote through to install and set up went without a hitch, would highly recommend them for a new solar system.I was very impressed with their work and all tradesmen were well organized.

Matt was very helpful with the quote process and explaining everything when I got confused and of all the quotes I got this one was the only one which was detailed all others were just a cost less rebate for total out of pocket cost.The guys that attended for the install were all very friendly and polite at all times, they were great with our dogs and did a great job of cleaning up before they left.Could not be happier with the process so far just hoping the meter change will be as efficient so the system can be turned on.

I must say Greenwave exceeded my expectations. From Sales, installation, commissioning and maintenance.All my call were answered promptly and all recommended systems were explained in great detail until I decided to which system was right for us.There workmanship and attention to detail and communication was perfect.Even when my internet glitched they popped round to re connect my inverter at the drop of a hat.We would like to say a big Thank you to the Greenwave Team.Outstanding products and outstanding serviceJoe & Jane Roche

The guys at Green Wave Solar made the whole job so easy. This is our story...We visited and contacted quite a few local providers. Most just asked for an address, and one even got back to us with a panel plan for the house roof. Pity the giant Marri would shade the roof where they planned to put the panels. And also completely ignored the fact we asked for the panels to be installed on our north facing shed roof.Another suggested we get an 'electrician mate' to assess our fuse box to see if we needed to upgrade anything before they would quote.And another said we would have to pay for a sparky to see if the shed power cable can handle the backfeed to the switchboard.Yet, with one email to Green Wave, they were out the same day to check out our shed, fuse box and suitability of our plan. And the quote followed that evening. A very detailed quote.We both work, so we never actually met Chris or any of the crew, so communication was key. And the trust was there straight away because of their responsiveness and honesty.From accepting the quote, to organising the meter upgrage, to installation, and the follow up, it has been nothing but seamless. Basically for us, it was: ask for a quote, and come home not long after to a fully working solar installation. And it was an extremelyneat and seamless job. Brilliant! And we are now saving money, and the planet, kind of.

After getting quotes from other suppliers and being left still very unsure we came across greenwave and got in contact. What a world of difference. Everything from sales through to the end was just straight to the point and none of this supplying a cheap crappy product just to make your prices look good. Will only recommend what they know works and are confident in. Very happy customer.

Green Wave provided a prompt response to my enquiry for our solar installation.Detailed explanation of the system, products used, warranty and application process etc.Very transparent.Communication throughout the application and installation was excellent. The installation team were polite, efficient and left the site clean and tidy.Can highly recommend them and would use them for future projects
Customer service and follow up excellent.Good guidance on product selection.Competitive pricing

Matt made it super easy for us on the application end, shielding us from all the head-butting he was having to do with the various bureaucratic authorities behind the scenes. The entire process was straightforward and easy.. thanks to Matt and Chris’s installation team. Great teamwork all the way around.Thankyou guys…

I have to say how thoroughly impressed and pleased I am with the whole experience. Awesome customer service, any questions promptly answered in detail and whole process was very easy and professional with quality materials.

The guys from Green Wave Solar made our installation a breeze. From first contact for a quote to final installation we found Greenwavesolar to be both courteous and professional.I cannot fault in any way  Matt and his team of tradesmen and I would recommend them to anyone thinking of installing a solar system.We also had a major problem with our hot water system and within 48 hours of contacting Matt we had a brand new I.Solar heat pump installed. Greenwave solar were honest and easy to deal with. No harassing phone calls from sales people and prompt installation.

Green Wave were excellent to deal with throughout the quote, system selection and installation process. Chris was responsive to my queries and offered the right technical solution at a fair price.
